visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Split screen setup; on the left, a man with a dark bowl cut wearing an olive-green military-style jacket, white T-shirt, and baggy white trousers stands against a plain cream-colored wall with white baseboards. On his head rest white-rimmed sunglasses. On the right, four people—two men and two women—sit on a grey fabric sofa. A small wooden table in front of them holds clear glass bottles and white ceramic mugs. The dancer on the left begins a rhythmic arm sequence, crossing his hands in front of his chest and moving them in symmetrical curves. (2) The dancer continues his fluid arm motions, focusing on creating specific geometric shapes with his hands. On the right side of the frame, a woman in a black strapless top leans forward, pointing aggressively towards the dancer with her right hand while shouting. The lighting in both scenes is bright and even, likely studio-lit. A large graphic of the LOEWE brand logo, featuring four interlaced 'L's, appears as a central overlay between the two screens. (3) A new visual phase begins as the dancer starts a rhythmic jumping motion, tucking his knees and moving his arms in a circular pattern to denote count. He wears black slide-on sandals. The group on the right is seen laughing, one man in a striped polo shirt covers his mouth in surprise. A mahjong tile graphic with eight circular dots appears on the screen. Bottles of clear liquid, possibly gin or vodka, are prominently placed on the table in the foreground. (4) The dancer transitions to a squatting position, using his hands to point at imaginary spots in the air, creating a four-dot pattern. Yellow variety-show style captions appear on the right side. The group on the couch is now holding a bottle and cheering loudly. The background remains a simple indoor living room setting with soft shadows. A mahjong tile with four green and red circles appears as an overlay graphic. (5) The dancer mimes three monkeys climbing by holding his sides and moving his shoulders in a rolling motion. On the right, the woman in the black top claps her hands excitedly. A brand logo for MONKEY SHOULDER featuring three monkeys is shown. The camera remains static for both sides of the split-screen throughout. (6) In the final phase, the dancer stands tall and raises both arms high above his head, fingers splayed wide to mimic the branching antlers of a stag. The group on the right points and laughs, clearly identifying the motion. A circular logo for DALMORE whisky, featuring a silver stag head, is overlaid on the screen. The scene ends with everyone smiling and applauding.
